sections.name: Introduction & Topic Statement
sections.description: Formulas to introduce and structure presentations and spoken arguments.

items.formula: Today, I would like to focus on...
items.mn: Өнөөдөр би ... дээр анхаарлаа хандуулахыг хүсэж байна.
items.en: Today, I would like to focus on...
items.de: Heute möchte ich mich auf ... konzentrieren.
items.example: Today, I would like to focus on sustainable urban development.

items.formula: The purpose of this presentation is to examine...
items.mn: Энэхүү илтгэлийн зорилго нь ...-ийг судлан авч үзэх явдал юм.
items.en: The purpose of this presentation is to examine...
items.de: Der Zweck dieses Vortrags ist es, ... zu untersuchen.
items.example: The purpose of this talk is to examine renewable energy transitions.

sections.name: Expressing Opinion
sections.description: Formulas to state and substantiate viewpoints.

items.formula: From my point of view, it is crucial that...
items.mn: Миний байр сууринаас үзэхэд ... нь нэн чухал юм.
items.en: From my point of view, it is crucial that...
items.de: Aus meiner Sicht ist es von entscheidender Bedeutung, dass...
items.example: From my point of view, it is crucial that we invest in early education.

items.formula: I am strongly inclined to believe that...
items.mn: Би ... гэдэгт ихээхэн итгэх хандлагатай байна.
items.en: I am strongly inclined to believe that...
items.de: Ich bin stark geneigt zu glauben, dass...
items.example: I am strongly inclined to believe that regular practice yields mastery.

sections.name: Weighing Pros & Cons
sections.description: Formulas to balance conflicting perspectives and advantages.

items.formula: While it is undeniably true that..., on the flip side...
items.mn: ... гэдэг нь маргаангүй үнэн хэдий ч, нөгөө талаас...
items.en: While it is undeniably true that..., on the flip side...
items.de: Während es unbestreitbar wahr ist, dass..., andererseits...
items.example: While automation boosts productivity, on the flip side it creates workforce displacement.

items.formula: The main benefit lies in..., whereas the primary drawback is...
items.mn: Гол ашиг тус нь ...-д орших бөгөөд гол дутагдал нь...
items.en: The main benefit lies in..., whereas the primary drawback is...
items.de: Der Hauptvorteil liegt in..., während der wesentliche Nachteil ... ist.
items.example: The main benefit lies in speed, whereas the primary drawback is high initial cost.

sections.name: Illustrating with Examples
sections.description: Formulas to support arguments with authentic examples.

items.formula: To illustrate this point, consider the case of...
items.mn: Энэ санааг тодруулахын тулд ...-ийн жишээг авч үзье.
items.en: To illustrate this point, consider the case of...
items.de: Um diesen Punkt zu veranschaulichen, betrachten wir den Fall von...
items.example: To illustrate this point, consider the case of Scandinavian public education.

items.formula: A notable case in point is...
items.en: A notable case in point is...
items.example: A notable case in point is the rapid expansion of solar power.

sections.name: Concluding & Summarizing
sections.description: Formulas to close an argument with precision.

items.formula: Taking everything into account, we can draw the conclusion that...
items.mn: Бүгдийг харгалзан үзээд бид ... гэсэн дүгнэлтэд хүрч чадна.
items.en: Taking everything into account, we can draw the conclusion that...
items.de: Alles in allem können wir den Schluss ziehen, dass...
items.example: Taking everything into account, we can draw the conclusion that proactive planning is essential.

items.formula: Thank you for your time and consideration. I would be pleased to answer questions.
items.mn: Цаг гарган анхаарсанд баярлалаа. Асуултуудад хариулахад таатай байх болно.
items.en: Thank you for your time and consideration. I would be pleased to answer questions.
items.de: Vielen Dank für Ihre Aufmerksamkeit. Ich beantworte gerne Ihre Fragen.
items.example: Thank you for your attention. I am happy to open the floor to questions.
